messages:
Priya: FYI we started a small smoke canary for a new micro-quantized variant and already see structured-output oddities when emitting funcalls. ~2.1% of samples show either invalid escapes or embedded control chars in tool args.

Sam: Can you paste an example?

Priya: From a traced session:
```
{"tool":"fetch_profile","args":{"q":"name:\\n\\u201CJin\\u201D"}}
```
Some streams deliver `\\n` as a literal newline inside the arg, others keep the escape; downstream tool interprets differently.

Ava: Baseline fp16 is ~0.01% for these cases, so it's a quantization-related regression.

Marta: Biggest risk is side-effectful tools getting bad params silently. If parser returns success we won't trigger retry protections.

Jin: Proposal: add a lightweight validator before invoking a tool that rejects args containing non-printable controls (excluding \n and \t). Return a structured error to the client and don't call the tool.

Sam: Also log token-cut metadata: model_variant, token_index_of_stream_boundary, raw_chunk_hex, and mark whether the escape sequence was split. That'll help us correlate tokenization shifts with corruptions.

Priya: We should be careful with auto-repair. If repair changes semantics (escaped -> literal newline) quarantine it instead. Repairs allowed: add missing trailing brace, close unbalanced quotes, re-escape stray control chars only if semantics preserved. Tag all repairs in telemetry.

Marta: I'll add telemetry dims: model_variant, parsed_ok, quarantined, repaired, repair_reason, tool_invoked_flag, idempotency_key. Also update the tool manifest with side_effect: true/false.

Sam: Implementation note: sanitizer lives in postprocess service, not runtime. If quarantined, return error code TOOL_QUARANTINED and include original_raw_output in logs (but not returned to user).

Jin: I'll run an offline pass of 25k historical funcall prompts through the quant model tonight to build an expected quarantine/repair taxonomy.

Priya: Plan: A/B canary at 50/50 for 6 hours with sanitizer in quarantine mode on the new variant. If quarantines >1% for any critical tool or double-invoke rate >0.3%, rollback.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: `microq-autoscan-quarantine-v1` -> staging. CI: 3/4 checks passing.

Ava: Add alert: quarantine rate >0.5% in 5m window -> pause canary.

Marta: Oncall runbook updated: check token-cut logs, run repair analyzer, escalate to model-owner if repairs exceed 40% of quarantines.

Sam: I'll push token-cut logger and the minimal quarantine handler by EOD. Priya, please share the offline eval CSV when ready.

Priya: Will post link once the run completes. Thanks everyone.
